map.二手房市场比较法评估工具，输入3个可比交易案例的价格及调整因素（区位、面积、楼层: Second-hand home market comparison method appraisal tool: enter the prices of 3 comparable transactions plus adjustment factors (location, area, floor, decoration, orientation, age) and it automatically computes a weighted average assessed value.
map.优先选同小区或 1 公里内、同户型朝向、近 3 个月成交，楼层与装修差异用调整系: Prefer comparables in the same development or within 1 km, with the same layout and orientation and sold in the last 3 months; offset floor and decoration differences with adjustment factors instead of forcing a cross-district comparison.
map.单套合理总调整多在 ±10% 内，超过说明案例可比性差或因素打分失真，应增换案例: For one comparable set, a sensible total adjustment usually stays within ±10%; going beyond that signals poor comparability or distorted factor scoring, and more comparables should be added or replaced.
map.卖房前用 3 个可比案例估算挂牌价。: Estimate the listing price with 3 comparable cases before selling.

map.：案例 2.5/2.6/2.7 万/㎡，均价 2.6 万；区位 +1%、楼层 +: : cases at 25,000 / 26,000 / 27,000 CNY per m2 give a mean of 26,000; location +1%, floor +1%, decoration +1%, orientation 0 and age 0 give a total adjustment of +3% -> an adjusted unit price of 26,780 CNY/m2; for 100 m2 the assessed total is 267,800 CNY.
map.：若总调整由 +3% 变为 −5%，单价由 2.678 万降到 2.47 万，总: : if the total adjustment changes from +3% to -5%, the unit price drops from 26,780 to 24,700 CNY and the total price differs by about 208,000 CNY, showing that factor scoring strongly affects the result and must be evidence-based.
